related.title: OAuth mTLS：存取 token 與用戶端憑證綁定
related.titleEn: OAuth mTLS: binding access tokens to client certificates
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：PR、錯受眾及未知workflow皆保留拒絕例；兩次百分比都可從12筆原始表重算，不用條件放寬換取通過。 交付12列workflow-contract.csv、兩版subject對照與核准SHA清單；交接包含受眾、issuer及repo限制的負責人。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Retain rejected PR, wrong-audience and unknown-workflow fixtures. Recompute both percentages from the original 12 rows without relaxing conditions merely to obtain a passing deployment. Deliver 12 workflow-contract rows, both subject representations and approved SHAs. The handover identifies owners of audience, issuer and repository restrictions, with no deployment credentials included.
related.difference: 列token簽章、issuer、audience、到期時間、cnf憑證指紋與TLS端呈現指紋六欄；先完成基本token驗證，再比較兩個指紋。
related.differenceEn: Record token signature result, issuer, audience, expiry, cnf certificate thumbprint and the certificate observed on TLS. Complete ordinary token validation before comparing the two thumbprints.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 雲端信任條件必須與實際subject樣板一致；environment不能被推論成分支仍在subject內。固定workflow版本與受眾條件分開檢查。 12筆中6筆符合repo與production環境；加入既定reusable workflow SHA要求後只有4筆符合；所有token描述皆採相同受眾。 環境條件覆蓋6/12×100=50%；完整workflow條件4/12×100=33.3333333%。沒有把PR事件自動當可信部署。
憑證綁定不能取代TLS身分驗證或token受眾驗證；代理終止TLS時，後端看到的憑證資訊必須有可信傳遞契約，不能信任任意header。 20筆已通過基本token驗證的請求中，16筆指紋一致；換證後有3筆仍攜舊token，維持相同20筆母體。 原始符合率16/20×100=80%；未同步換發token後13/20×100=65%。綁定不符的請求必須拒絕而非延用舊指紋。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Cloud trust conditions must match the actual subject template. An environment context does not imply the branch remains encoded in the subject. Verify pinned workflow identity and audience independently. Six of 12 rows satisfy repository and production-environment conditions. Adding the approved reusable-workflow SHA requirement leaves four; all token descriptors share the same configured audience. The environment conditions admit 6/12×100=50%; the complete workflow conditions admit 4/12×100=33.3333333%. A pull-request event is never automatically treated as a trusted deployment.

Certificate binding does not replace TLS authentication or token-audience validation. When a proxy terminates TLS, certificate evidence delivered to the backend needs a trusted propagation contract rather than an arbitrary client-controlled header. Of 20 requests passing basic token checks, 16 have matching thumbprints. After a certificate rotation, three of those retain old bound tokens; keep the same 20-request population. Matching rate is 16/20×100=80%; unsynchronized token renewal reduces it to 13/20×100=65%. A binding mismatch is rejected rather than accepted through an old-thumbprint fallback.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: TUF：根中繼資料輪替的雙門檻驗證
related.titleEn: TUF: dual-threshold verification during root rotation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：PR、錯受眾及未知workflow皆保留拒絕例；兩次百分比都可從12筆原始表重算，不用條件放寬換取通過。 交付12列workflow-contract.csv、兩版subject對照與核准SHA清單；交接包含受眾、issuer及repo限制的負責人。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Retain rejected PR, wrong-audience and unknown-workflow fixtures. Recompute both percentages from the original 12 rows without relaxing conditions merely to obtain a passing deployment. Deliver 12 workflow-contract rows, both subject representations and approved SHAs. The handover identifies owners of audience, issuer and repository restrictions, with no deployment credentials included.
related.difference: 建立版本N與N+1根描述，分開列舊keyid集合、新集合及各門檻；對版本跳號、未知keyid及重複簽章各建負例。
related.differenceEn: Build root descriptors for versions N and N+1 with separate old and new key sets and thresholds. Add skipped-version, unknown-key and repeated-signature counterexamples before evaluating the proposed transition.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 雲端信任條件必須與實際subject樣板一致；environment不能被推論成分支仍在subject內。固定workflow版本與受眾條件分開檢查。 12筆中6筆符合repo與production環境；加入既定reusable workflow SHA要求後只有4筆符合；所有token描述皆採相同受眾。 環境條件覆蓋6/12×100=50%；完整workflow條件4/12×100=33.3333333%。沒有把PR事件自動當可信部署。
同一新根須依舊根與新根要求各自驗證；一個KEYID只能計一次。以每側有效唯一簽章數除以門檻，再取較小值，作為本課的瓶頸指標。 舊根門檻2且有效唯一簽章2，新根門檻3且有效唯一簽章2；另外附一份重複的新根簽章，不能增加計數。 瓶頸min(2/2,2/3)=2/3；補第三個有效新keyid後min(2/2,3/3)=1，兩側才都足額。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Cloud trust conditions must match the actual subject template. An environment context does not imply the branch remains encoded in the subject. Verify pinned workflow identity and audience independently. Six of 12 rows satisfy repository and production-environment conditions. Adding the approved reusable-workflow SHA requirement leaves four; all token descriptors share the same configured audience. The environment conditions admit 6/12×100=50%; the complete workflow conditions admit 4/12×100=33.3333333%. A pull-request event is never automatically treated as a trusted deployment.

Verify the proposed root under both old and new requirements, counting each KEYID once. Divide valid unique signatures by each threshold and take the smaller ratio as a local bottleneck indicator; acceptance still requires both sides to meet their thresholds. The old threshold is two with two valid unique signatures; the new threshold is three with two. Include a duplicate new-root signature object, which must not increase the count or disguise the missing independent signer. The bottleneck is min(2/2, 2/3)=2/3. Adding a third valid new KEYID makes min(2/2, 3/3)=1. A ratio below one identifies an unmet quorum, not a percentage probability of compromise.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
